No two-round minimal line-percolating set in PG(2,5): a counterexample to Conjecture 20 of Gerbner-Keszegh-Meszaros-Patkos-Vizer (arXiv:1608.00531)

Myeongjin Kang

Abstract

Conjecture 20 fails at the allowed boundary (q,r) = (5,5): in PG(2,5) no inclusion-minimal percolating set has percolation time 2 at threshold 5.

AI-assisted research preprint. The scoped main statement has a Lean certificate. Internal AI review is not external journal peer review; bounded prior-art searches do not certify worldwide priority. See the paper for exact qualifications and formalization limits.
